result.reason: The clause largely tracks the fallback by making the restriction mutual, limiting it to directly involved personnel, retaining the advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs, and imposing no no-hire. However, it applies throughout the entire Term in addition to 12 months after each individual’s involvement ends. If an individual ceases involvement well before the Term ends, the restriction may exceed 12 months from that date, contrary to the fallback. The margin comment inaccurately describes the operative duration.
